description: K₆Na₃Ti₂Al₂Si₈O₂₆Cl₃ is Esseneite-derived structured and crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are three inequivalent K sites. In the first K site, K is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to six O and two Cl atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.82-3.23 Å. There is one shorter (3.12 Å) and one longer (3.17 Å) K-Cl bond length. In the second K site, K is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to six O and two Cl atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.82-3.23 Å. There is one shorter (3.12 Å) and one longer (3.17 Å) K-Cl bond length. In the third K site, K is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to five O and two Cl atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.97-3.34 Å. There is one shorter (3.24 Å) and one longer (3.27 Å) K-Cl bond length. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O and two equivalent Cl atoms to form distorted NaCl₂O₄ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaCl₂O₄ octahedra, corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaCl₂O₄ octahedra, and edges with two TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 66°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.46 Å. Both Na-Cl bond lengths are 2.86 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four O and two equivalent Cl atoms to form distorted NaCl₂O₄ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaCl₂O₄ octahedra, corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent AlO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 66°. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.37 Å. Both Na-Cl bond lengths are 3.12 Å. There are two inequivalent Ti sites. In the first Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaCl₂O₄ octahedra. All Ti-O bond lengths are 1.98 Å. In the second Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaCl₂O₄ octahedra. All Ti-O bond lengths are 1.98 Å. Al is bonded to four O atoms to form AlO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one NaCl₂O₄ octahedra. There are a spread of Al-O bond distances ranging from 1.75-1.77 Å. There are four inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one TiO₆ octahedra, corners with two NaCl₂O₄ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one AlO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 48-68°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.66 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one TiO₆ octahedra, corners with two NaCl₂O₄ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one AlO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 48-68°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.65 Å. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaCl₂O₄ octahedra, corners with two TiO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one AlO₄ tetrahedra, and  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-67°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.67 Å. In the fourth Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaCl₂O₄ octahedra, corners with two TiO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one AlO₄ tetrahedra, and  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-67°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.67 Å. There are thirteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two K, one Ti, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two K, one Ti, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two K and two Si atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two K and two Si atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent K, one Al, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent K, one Al, and one Si atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one K, one Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one K, one Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one K, one Na, one Ti, and one Si atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one K, one Na, one Ti, and one Si atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one K and two Si atoms. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one Si atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one Si atom. There are two inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded to three K and three Na atoms to form distorted ClK₃Na₃ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ClK₃Na₃ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one ClK₃Na₃ octahedra, and  a faceface with one ClK₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded to six K atoms to form distorted face-sharing ClK₆ octahedra.
